subject: Request: purge of assistant derivatives, KV cache, and inference logs — GreenBridge
messages:
From: GreenBridge Health <ops@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deletion request: assistant derivatives + KV cache + inference logs

Hi Laura / Marissa,

We need Redwood's confirmation and execution plan to permanently delete all assistant-derived artifacts for the GreenBridge Health account created between 2025-01-01 and 2026-11-01. Specifically:
- Prompt inputs and derivative outputs stored in prompt-output logs
- KV-cache material related to model session ids prefixed with gbh-
- Inference access logs and any temporary traces (request/response pairs) retained for debugging

GreenBridge legal and security have approved the deletion request; attached is our intake form. Please provide: a) scope of objects to be wiped, b) schedule for the wipe, c) a hash-signed proof artifact (manifest) and d) retention/exclusion confirmation (e.g., backups, snapshots).

We anticipate needing a tamper-evident proof bundle and a signed acknowledgement to satisfy our auditors. No legal hold on these records.

Thanks,
Harry Patel
Head of Ops, GreenBridge Health
ops@greenbridgehealth.com

Attachment: gbh_deletion_intake.pdf (form, 120KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deletion request: assistant derivatives + KV cache + inference logs

Hi Harry — thanks for the clear intake.

Summary of next steps from Redwood:
1) Scope confirmation: we will target all prompt-output buckets labeled /accounts/greenbridge/*, KV cache entries with session prefix gbh-, and inference request logs for the date range provided.
2) Schedule: propose Tue 2026-11-03 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic window in eu-west-1). Please confirm.
3) Proof: we'll produce a signed manifest CSV (columns: object_path, SHA256, deletion_timestamp) and a compressed evidence bundle (signed metadata + sweep logs).
4) Backups/snapshots: we will enumerate any S3 lifecycle snapshots and either expire or provide separate evidence for those objects — please confirm if you require immediate snapshot deletion or an attest-only approach.

Attached is a wipe_manifest_template.csv (fill-in for auditing). Aditya will author the wipe run and provide the log after execution.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: wipe_manifest_template.csv (stub)

Laura / Marissa — technical runbook below. I'll run the job during the proposed window unless you instruct otherwise.

Planned execution (eu-west-1):
- 02:00 UTC: quiesce incoming GBH inference traffic (route gbh account to degradation bucket; preserve SLA for others).
- 02:05 UTC: generate snapshot manifest for target buckets/prefixes and write to ephemeral, access-restricted storage for hashing.
- 02:15 UTC: run bucket/object deletion routine with multi-threaded workers (idempotent deletes).
- 02:40 UTC: sweep KV cache cluster (entries with key prefix gbh-), invalidate local caches and prune on-disk caches.
- 02:50 UTC: collect inference-edge logs (request_id pairs) and securely shred temporary traces.
- 03:00 UTC: produce signed manifest CSV and tar.gz evidence bundle, GPG-signed with Redwood key; push to shared evidence Drive link and deliver to customer.
- 03:15 UTC: final verification pass and reconciliation of deleted object counts versus manifest.

Attachments: wipe-run-20261103.log (post-run), final_evidence_bundle.tar.gz (GPG-signed) — I'll attach after the run.

Caveats / notes:
- Snapshots: if any RDS/backup snapshots reference the same objects, list them explicitly. We can expire snapshots older than your retention window but deletion of snapshot contents may require a separate job (we flagged none in the initial scan).
- Legal hold: this run assumes no hold. If you discover a hold mid-execution, we'll pause and quarantine outputs.

Aditya Rao
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
